svg.text: 26 agents across 3 identity pipelines + shared Moments service layer
Selects pipeline(s), sequences stages, runs Trigger Analyst prerequisite
Life-transition scan across 6 dimensions | Decomposed Switching Intent (Compulsion x Friction)
Weighted composite scoring | Classification tags | Window types | Trigger Event Library
+ acquisition moment, window type, switching origin
Tempo: months analysis, years investment | 3-30+ yr
Path A: PESTEL/Velocity-driven (existing) | Path B: Moment-driven identity communities (new) | [Path A+B] = 1.15x confidence boost at Stage 3
Prolific instrument design, analysis plan -- serves all pipelines
G/Y/R verdicts, statistical analysis, feedback loop triggers
Marketing briefs from any pipeline's Stage 4
Moments Service -- shared upstream, trigger event library, feeds all 3 pipelines, 1 agent
Surge Trends -- demand spikes (<3mo), velocity-first, flash moments via Step 1B, 5 agents
Micro-Trends Identity -- emerging waves (3mo-3yr), dual-entry qualification (Path A + B), 5 agents
Macro-Trends Identity -- structural shifts (3-30+yr), full ethnographic depth + switching profiles, 6 agents
Trigger Analyst runs once as shared upstream service, feeds all 3 pipelines
Dual-entry: Path A (PESTEL) + Path B (moment-driven) at each pipeline's Stage 1
No standalone Moments pipeline -- moments absorbed into identity pipelines
Switching profiles & interception concepts absorbed into Stage 4A/4B agents
All pipelines converge at shared Stage 5 and Tiers 3-4
Orchestration (1) + Moments Service (1) + Surge (5) + Micro (5) + Macro (6) + Shared Stage 5 (2) + Campaign (4) + Partners (2) = 26 agents
